REBALANCEDSPIRE-AFTERLIFE.description:
At the start of your turn, [gold]Osty[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
If [gold]Osty[/gold] is dead, [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()} instead.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-BOLAS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the start of your next turn, return this to your [gold]Hand[/gold], and increase its attack damage by {IncrementAmount:diff()}.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-CONSUMING_SHADOW.descrip: Channeled [gold]Dark[/gold] gain half of the damage of the last [gold]Evoked Dark[/gold].
REBALANCEDSPIRE-CORPSE_EXPLOSION.descrip:
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold]. 
When the enemy dies, deal damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-CORPSE_EXPLOSION.title: Corpse Explosion
REBALANCEDSPIRE-FOLLOW_THROUGH.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If the last card you played this turn was a Skill, apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.descrip:
If you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
REBALANCEDSPIRE-GLASSWORK.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold].
Increase the damage of your [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs by {IfUpgraded:show:3|2}.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-RIGHT_HAND_HAND.descript:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you play a card costing {Required:energyIcons()} or more, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and reduce its cost by {Energy:energyIcons()}.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-SIC_EM.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy, [gold]Summon[/gold] {SicEmPlusPower:diff()}.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-SPINNER.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} [gold]Glass[/gold], and trigger the passive ability of all [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs.
REBALANCEDSPIRE-SPUR.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
Excess healing beyond max HP counts as [gold]Summon[/gold].
REBALANCEDSPIRE-SYNCHRONIZE.description:
Record newly [gold]Channeled[/gold] orb.
The first time you record a new type of Orb, gain {SynchronizePlusPower:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold].
REBALANCEDSPIRE-WISH.description: Put a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
